name: Misty Hearts
original_name: หัวใจในสายหมอก
overview: Mei Lin, a burnout cartoonist. Come to Phayao Province to find new inspiration. Unexpectedly, they meet Niran, a discreet and sober hotel manager who has a heart hidden from a small misunderstanding on the first day, gradually becoming learning about each other, through travel, art, nature, and honest conversations.
